messages:
customer-acme: Hey, hitting a production issue — our rerank endpoint is returning extremely low / zeroed scores when we pass embeddings from our embed calls. No 4xx/5xx, just wrong ranks. Reported after a deploy last night. Request id: rrk-0a1b2c3d.

liz-support: Thanks for the report — can you paste the exact payload (sanitized) and the embed model you used? Also the rerank model name.

customer-acme: Sure. Embeds were generated with model: embed-alpha-1536. Reranker used: rerank-pro-2048. Payload: ```json
{
  "query": "find red sneakers",
  "items": ["doc1","doc2","doc3"],
  "query_embedding": [0.12, 0.03, ...],  // length 1536
  "item_embeddings": [[...], [...], [...]]  // length 1536 each
}
```
Scores come back like: [0.0, -0.0001, 0.0] which is obviously wrong.

liz-support: Hmm looks like the reranker might expect 2048-dim vectors. We usually validate lengths but maybe that check skipped for this code path. @aj-eng-ml can you weigh in?

aj-eng-ml: I can repro locally — sending 1536-dim vectors into rerank-pro-2048 leads to implicit truncation/padding in the model-to-backend path and results in meaningless dot products. Server didn't raise an error; it treated the vector as-is and the backend kernel assumed 2048 dims, reading memory past EOF or zero-padding depending on path.

sam-oncall: Is this a regression from last night's deploy?

aj-eng-ml: Yes, deployment 2025-06-06T03:00 rolled a change that moved strict shape checks from the API gateway into model-serving layer for performance. The gateway path used by mixed embed+rerank flows missed the check.

liz-support: For the customer: immediate workaround?

aj-eng-ml: Two options: 1) Regenerate embeddings with a compatible embed model (embed-pro-2048) — easiest and safest. 2) If they must use current vectors, zero-pad to 2048 dims on client side as a temporary hack (not ideal).

liz-support: OK informing customer with those options. Also flagging that we should return 400 when embedding length != model.expected_dim. @sam-oncall can you open a P0 and roll a hotfix?

sam-oncall: Opening incident and tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml. Immediate plan: revert the change to validation behavior or re-add a cheap length check at the API ingress. Rolling a patch to add explicit length validation now.

infra-bot: deploy-pipeline: started job infra/validate-embed-dim-checks #4521

aj-eng-ml: For the longer term: add a clear contract in docs and enforce at the API boundary. Also add telemetry: counter of mismatched-dim calls and a customer-facing diagnostic header returned when we auto-pad/truncate.

liz-support: Customer also mentioned billing concerns — they were charged many rerank calls that produced garbage ranks. @finance-jay can we provision a credit while we investigate?

finance-jay: Will review usage for account acme-corp today and propose a credit. Please attach the request id and approximate token/call counts.

liz-support: Repro steps for eng team (minimal):
```bash
# generate 1536-dim embed (simulate)
python -c "import json; print(json.dumps({'embedding':[0.01]*1536}))" > q.json
# call rerank endpoint that expects 2048 dims
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query_embedding": [0.01,...1536 vals...], "items": [[0.01,...]]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank?model=rerank-pro-2048
```
Please use request id rrk-0a1b2c3d for logs.

aj-eng-ml: Confirmed local repro. I'll push a validation patch that returns 400 with this message: "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 2048, got 1536". Also adding a soft fallback flag that will reject-by-default; we can consider auto-padding behind a feature flag.

sam-oncall: Patch ready, running e2e. ETA to prod ~35m if green.

liz-support: I'll send customer the workaround + ETA and offer a temporary credit.

customer-acme: Thanks — we'll try regenerating with embed-pro-2048 for now. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

infra-bot: deploy-pipeline: job infra/validate-embed-dim-checks #4521 succeeded

sam-oncall: Patch deployed to prod. API now responds 400 + clear error on dim mismatch. Rolling back the lenient path. Monitoring for related errors.

liz-support: Closing the loop with customer and initiating credit per finance. Created internal doc to add a faq entry: "How to mix embeddings and rerank models".

aj-eng-ml: Follow-ups: (1) add automated alert for >5% mismatched-dim calls per customer, (2) update SDKs to surface model dim metadata, (3) add unit test to prevent future regressions.

finance-jay: Credit issued for acme-corp: $1200 pending approval.

liz-support: Thanks everyone — marking thread resolved. If any anomalies crop up, reopening with logs.
